workflow.name: before_turn_retrieval
workflow.description: 每轮开始前自动检索：短消息(≤4字)只看最近3轮；长消息走语义检索+episodic记忆+关键词筛→LLM精排top3→格式化注入（before_turn 钩子，默认开）

out.name: result
out.description: 格式化文本：找到 N 条：- [id](episodic) 标题：预览

node.title: collect_candidates
node.code:
import json, re def _first_s(text): t=(text or "").strip(); m=re.search(r'[。！？\n]', t) return t[:m.start()].strip() if m and m.start()>=10 else t[:60] def _md_hs(text): hs,seen=[],set() for line in text.split('\n'): m=re.match(r'(#{1,3})\s+(.+)', line.strip()) if m: h=m.group(2).strip() if h not in seen: seen.add(h); hs.append(h) return hs[:4] def _snips(text,kws,ctx=40): tl=(text or "").lower() if not tl or not kws: return "" seen,parts=set(),[] for k in kws: pos=tl.find(k.lower()) if pos<0 or pos in seen: continue seen.add(pos) s=max(0,pos-ctx); e=min(len(text),pos+len(k)+ctx) frag=text[s:e] if s>0: frag="…"+frag if e<len(text): frag+="…" parts.append(frag) if len(parts)>=3: break return " | ".join(parts) if parts else ""
async def main(args) -> dict: history = args.params.get("history") or [] kws = args.params.get("keywords") or [] sem = args.params.get("semantic_hits") or [] epi_txt = args.params.get("episodic") or "" cands = [] # ---- 语义结果 ---- for s in sem: tidx = s.get("turn_idx",0) text = s.get("text","") or f"(语义命中 第{tidx}轮)" cands.append({"kind":"semantic","turn_idx":tidx,"text":text,"score":float(s.get("score",0))*3}) # ---- Episodic记忆 ---- if isinstance(epi_txt, str) and epi_txt.startswith("找到"): for m in re.finditer(r"- \[([^\]]+)\]\((\w+)\)\s*([^：\n]+)：(.+)", epi_txt): rid, _t, title, preview = m.groups() cands.append({"kind":"epi","turn_idx":0,"id":rid, "text":f"{title.strip()}：{preview.strip()}","score":2}) if not kws and not history: pass else: kl = [k.lower() for k in kws] for item in reversed(history): tidx = item.get("turn",0) u = item.get("user","") or ""; a = item.get("answer","") or "" ul=u.lower(); al=a.lower() hu=[k for k in kl if k in ul]; ha=[k for k in kl if k in al] if hu or ha: parts=[] us=_snips(u,hu) or u[:60] if us: parts.append(f"用户: {us}") if hu: parts.append(f"命中: {', '.join(hu)}") fs=_first_s(a) if fs: parts.append(f"回答: {fs}") sa=_snips(a,ha) if sa and sa!=fs: parts.append(f"回答(命中): {sa}") hs=_md_hs(a) if hs: parts.append(f"章节: {' > '.join(hs)}") cands.append({"kind":"turn","turn_idx":tidx,"text":" | ".join(parts),"score":len(hu)+len(ha)}) for step in item.get("steps",[]): for tc in step.get("tool_calls",[]): name_full = tc.get("name","") or "" args_full = json.dumps(tc.get("arguments"),ensure_ascii=False) result_full = tc.get("result","") or "" n=name_full.lower(); ar=args_full.lower(); rt=result_full.lower() hk=[k for k in kl if k in n or k in ar or k in rt] s=len(hk) if s>0: cid = tc.get("call_id","") parts=[f"工具: {name_full} ({cid})"] ns=_snips(name_full,hk) if ns and ns!=name_full: parts.append(f"名称命中: {ns}") asnip=_snips(args_full,hk) if asnip: parts.append(f"入参命中: {asnip}") rs=_snips(result_full,hk) if rs: parts.append(f"结果命中: {rs}") if hk: parts.append(f"命中词: {', '.join(hk)}") cands.append({"kind":"tc","turn_idx":tidx,"call_id":cid, "text":" | ".join(parts),"score":s}) cands.sort(key=lambda x:-x["score"])
# ========== 核心改造：生成统一字典，value 即为最终显示文本 ========== candidates = [] candidates_display = [] for i, c in enumerate(cands[:10]): cid = f"cand_{i}" kind = c.get("kind", "") tidx = c.get("turn_idx", 0) text = c.get("text", "") if kind == "epi": display = f"[epi·长期记忆] {text}" else: display = f"[第{tidx}轮] [{kind}] {text}" candidates_display.append(display) candidates.append(text)
return {"candidates_display": candidates_display, "candidates":candidates}
